purpose: Where each merchant publishes its subscription terms and how to find the part that governs cancelling: data, not code (Rail 3, packages/domain/72-merchant-terms.js). A fact rule only fires when its phrase is literally in the fetched text, and the phrase is quoted back.
verified_note: No entry has been read from the live page from this environment (its network policy blocks these hosts). The parse hints and phrases are modeled on the published wording as quoted by third-party mirrors (tostracker.app, conductatlas.com) and are proven only against tests/fixtures/terms/*.html. An entry becomes verified when a live read extracts its section and the hash is recorded.

refund_policy.pattern: (?:do not|don't) provide refunds or credits for any partial(?:[- ]month)? membership periods
refund_policy.value: no refunds or credits for partial periods
